definition: Foolishly and deeply attracted to someone, with little good sense.
author: Henry James
quote: But I was infatuated—I was blind with victory, though even then the very effect that was to have brought him so much nearer was already that of added separation.
example_sentence: He was infatuated with the girl from the bakery.
